purpose: Reproducible record of how hp_noise001 was selected as the top GP candidate for the online phase (T12), so the 7 length scales are re-derivable without the untracked offline workspace.

offline_search.source_script: 外推方案/gp提分/run_variant.py (untracked local directory; config block quoted below)

config_block_for_hp_noise001.notes: Variant 'hp_noise001' (1c): fixed noise level, relaxed upper bound on length scales, multi-start L-BFGS-B. Baseline 'base' used bounds=(0.03,3.0), n_starts=1, maxiter=18, noise optimised in (0.001,0.3).

offline_oof_scores.notes: These are OOF (frozen 2x5x3 splits, 10 folds) scores from the offline summary JSONs in the untracked workspace. The blend-tree summaries were generated separately under the offline v3.2 protocol.

offline_search.selection_rule: Shortlist of six candidates ranked by offline surrogate scoring v3.2; real-data evaluation on R < 180 (see § Real-data ranking below) showed pure-GP candidates outperformed the blend-tree ones despite lower offline scores.

dataset_eval_log.path: user workspace: eval_log.jsonl (from github.com/muzhilianhua/SDM374_Project-1 branch origin/online, commit 33b8078, 6568 rows, 6548 unique after dedup)

dataset_all_real_extrap.path: merged offline training rows + round1_search + round2_search + candidate_truth, minus dataset_same8/train.csv

six_candidate_ranks_by_RMSE.agreement: 4 of 6 rank positions are identical across both datasets; blend_xgb_w20x3 and blend_histgb_low80 are swapped (ranks 5<->6).

real_data_ranking.takeaway: hp_noise001 (pure GP) is best-performing among the six shortlisted candidates in the R < 180 region on both independent real-data sets, outranking blend-tree models that scored higher on the offline surrogate-scoring v3.2 metric.

related_decisions.decision_21: Each building's 7 weights must sum to 1 and be non-negative; the GP is NOT scale-invariant, so `ModelBundle.predict` enforces the simplex check.
related_decisions.decision_27: Local evaluator runs, including the real-solver eval_log, may be used to choose the model (recorded with PR #20); hp_noise001 fits the frozen 2048 training rows only and embeds no locally measured point or R value.
related_decisions.decision_19: Only the 2048 training rows before the first online call are legal for fitting; hp_noise001 does not violate this.
